{
  "clearExpectedBehavior": true,
  "rationale": "The report explicitly requires one listed mana charge per successful cast and no additional mana charge or cooldown extension on a rejected recast. ChampionKit lists Morgana E at 70 mana and 14 seconds; DexArena.Cast calls BeginCast, whose original deduction is twice the listed cost. The trace reproduces a 140-mana deduction while confirming a successful shield cast. Retain success and active-cooldown controls alongside the report-derived resource assertions. These checks cover this cast and recast, not every ability.",
  "checks": [
    {
      "label": "Successful cast charges listed mana once",
      "at": "successful_cast",
      "unit": "player",
      "field": "mana",
      "relation": "eq",
      "compareAt": "initial",
      "compareUnit": "player",
      "compareField": "mana",
      "value": -70,
      "tolerance": 0.001
    },
    {
      "label": "Shield confirms successful cast",
      "at": "successful_cast",
      "unit": "player",
      "field": "shield",
      "relation": "gt",
      "compareAt": "",
      "compareUnit": "",
      "compareField": "",
      "value": 0,
      "tolerance": 0.001
    },
    {
      "label": "Successful cast starts original cooldown",
      "at": "successful_cast",
      "unit": "player",
      "field": "readyE",
      "relation": "eq",
      "compareAt": "initial",
      "compareUnit": "world",
      "compareField": "time",
      "value": 14,
      "tolerance": 0.001
    },
    {
      "label": "Recast attempted during active cooldown",
      "at": "before_recast",
      "unit": "player",
      "field": "cooldownE",
      "relation": "gt",
      "compareAt": "",
      "compareUnit": "",
      "compareField": "",
      "value": 0,
      "tolerance": 0.001
    },
    {
      "label": "Rejected recast spends no mana",
      "at": "cooldown_recast",
      "unit": "player",
      "field": "mana",
      "relation": "eq",
      "compareAt": "before_recast",
      "compareUnit": "player",
      "compareField": "mana",
      "value": 0,
      "tolerance": 0.001
    },
    {
      "label": "Rejected recast preserves readiness deadline",
      "at": "cooldown_recast",
      "unit": "player",
      "field": "readyE",
      "relation": "eq",
      "compareAt": "before_recast",
      "compareUnit": "player",
      "compareField": "readyE",
      "value": 0,
      "tolerance": 0.001
    }
  ]
}
